parameters.start: ={{ (() => { const start = DateTime.fromISO($json.body?.args?.start_time || $json.body?.start_time || $json.args?.start_time || $json.start_time).setZone('America/New_York'); const now = DateTime.now().setZone('America/New_York'); if (!start.isValid) throw new Error('INVALID_APPOINTMENT_START'); if (start <= now) throw new Error('PAST_APPOINTMENT_REJECTED'); return start.toISO(); })() }}
parameters.end: ={{ (() => { const start = DateTime.fromISO($json.body?.args?.start_time || $json.body?.start_time || $json.args?.start_time || $json.start_time).setZone('America/New_York'); const now = DateTime.now().setZone('America/New_York'); if (!start.isValid) throw new Error('INVALID_APPOINTMENT_START'); if (start <= now) throw new Error('PAST_APPOINTMENT_REJECTED'); return start.plus({ minutes: 30 }).toISO(); })() }}
